marks.gloss_en: שאילו רבי יוסי קיים, היה כפוף ויושב לפני רבי
דהא רבי ישמעאל ברבי יוסי, דממלא מקום אבותיו הוה, כפוף ויושב לפני רבי
וקאמר: כבר הורה זקן -- and yet Rabbi deferred to R' Yosei
Rav Pappa: come and see how much they cherished one another
כשמואל -- דאמר רב יהודה אמר שמואל: מותר להטמין את הצונן (the insulating)
כרב -- דאמר רב שמואל בר רב יצחק אמר רב: כל שהוא נאכל כמות שהוא חי אין בו משום בישולי גוים (the water)
Rav: whatever is eaten as it is, raw, is not subject to [the prohibition of] gentile cooking
והתניא: רבי התיר להטמין את הצונן! -- the baraita has Rabbi permitting what Rav Huna reports him forbidding
לא קשיא: הא מקמי דלישמעיה מרבי ישמעאל ברבי יוסי, הא לבתר דלישמעיה -- the prohibition preceded, the permission followed his hearing R' Yosei's ruling (the incident: אבא התיר ... כבר הורה זקן)
it is forbidden to insulate the cold
מאי טעמא איקפד? כרבוותיה עביד -- why was R' Ami angry? Rav Nachman acted as his teachers ruled
Rav Nachman to Daru his slave: insulate cold food for me
(הוא) סבר אדם חשוב שאני -- R' Ami held that an important person is different (= p_adam_chashuv_shani)
he held: an important person is different
if he did not cover it while it was still day, he may not cover it after dark
Shmuel: it is permitted to insulate the cold
Abaye: Shmuel teaches that even a thing that is usually insulated may be insulated cold
השתא אוקורי קא מקיר להו, ארתוחי קא מרתח להו -- having cooled the water by pouring it, he will not come to boil it (no SupportKind names a stated rationale)
RSBG: they prohibited [insulating after nightfall] only [in] that same urn
[the Sages] said: one may not insulate, even in a thing that does not add heat, after nightfall
[if] he insulated and covered with a thing movable on Shabbat, or insulated in an unmovable thing and covered with a movable one -- he takes [the pot] out and returns it
[if] he insulated and covered with a thing not movable on Shabbat, or insulated in a movable thing and covered with an unmovable one -- if part of it was exposed, he takes out and returns
